content: Duyaghala Zhanlien Bu Gholu
Tai dundadu sugienduku eghinduku khalase irezho? Tai sudorodu nefuxin khudoghozhi khizhesan pushonu?
Ta tanxin giesanne kerezhi echi dase kunlai alane. Dubiliezhi yama kerezhi echi dase eghinduzhi sugiendune. Ta kerezhi echi dakushi xiahua ese giezho.
Xiahua giedene kerezhi echi dakushi tai muji ese oluzho. Ta keresanne goya nefuxin jiere injine giezho.
Ta ene piofen giechen kunla, ta duyaghala zhanlien gholuse Hudaghala duitou gholusei ulie mejienu? Kienliuzhe duyaghala zhanlien gholune giese Hudaghala duitou gholuzho.
Pse ta sumulase Huda matai sudoro teisan ruhherde neiizhi dubiliekude kuruzho giesan jinwunni kielien yama isi uwonu?
Ingieliuzhe Huda ogisan nenjien genjia olon wo. Jinwun jiere kieliesan mutun,

content.text: "Huda goyane undude uzhesan kunlai fandui giene.
Goyane meilade uzhesan kunlade nenjien ogine."

content: Ingiese ta Hudai shunji. Ibilisii danla. Ibilisi tanse piine.
Ta Hudai shigha. Huda tai shighane. Zuirenla, khane ganjinragha. Zhuine barei dasan kunla, zhughene ganjinragha.
Ta yuchou giezhi nango giezhi wila. Tai xiniedunyi nango gholugha. Bayasukui yuchou gholugha.
Ta Ezhanyi melie goyane boghonide uzhe, ingiese hhe tai undudaghane.
Kunlai Bu Kielie
Gaijiula, ta nieniene bu sugie. Kien gaijiune sugiezhi kieliese guijinni sugiezhi kieliezho. Ta guijinni kieliese guijinni zunjisan kun pusho, panjiku noyen gholuwo.
Guijinni jinjichen, panjichen zi niekozi wo. Hheshi kunni jiui shidaku, widagha shidaku Huda wo. Kunlai kieliezhi chishi kien wo?
Goyane Bu Kuaizhi Hudade Kouizhi Gie
"Enedu, maghashijie matan khalakhala chenshide echi, niehon souzhi meimei giezhi baer zhenjiye." giezhi kieliesan kunla, chenliendu.
Ta maghashijie matui gholukui ulie mejiene. Tai aminshi yan wo? Khizhese deigo widaku tuman wo.
Ta indan ingiezhi kieliekuni wo, "Ezhan duran bise matan aminne olune, enei giene, hheiye giene."
Ingieliuzhe ta goyane undude uzhezhi kuaine. Qingiezhi kuaikushi man doghunni wo.
Ingiese kun gouni giekui mejiedene ulie giese zui fanjizho.
